headline: **MLB Daily Roundup: July 20, 2026**
article:
The Minnesota Twins suffered a blowout loss in Cleveland, falling 13-4 to the Guardians. Petey Halpin led the Twins' offense with 3 hits, including 2 home runs. Meanwhile, the New York Yankees secured a 5-8 victory over the Pittsburgh Pirates, with Jazz Chisholm Jr. leading the Pirates' offense with 2 hits, 2 home runs, and 5 RBIs.

Several key players have been placed on the injured list, including Miami Marlins right-hander Max Meyer, who has been placed on the 15-day injured list due to a neck strain. Other players affected by injuries include Chicago Cubs right-hander Phil Maton, San Diego Padres designated hitter Miguel Andujar, Baltimore Orioles catcher Adley Rutschman, Detroit Tigers right-hander Will Vest, Washington Nationals left-hander PJ Poulin, and Washington Nationals left-hander Richard Lovelady.

The Los Angeles Dodgers have acquired right-handed pitcher Seth Halvorsen in a trade with the Colorado Rockies, sending right-handed pitcher Nick Frasso and outfielder Landyn Vidourek to the Rockies in exchange. The Chicago Cubs have also made a trade, acquiring right-hander Aaron Civale from the Athletics in exchange for right-hander Aiden Moffett. Additionally, the Baltimore Orioles have acquired right fielder Rudy Martin Jr. from the Kansas City Royals in exchange for cash.

top_news.title: **Twins Suffer Blowout Loss in Cleveland**
top_news.summary: The Minnesota Twins fell to the Cleveland Guardians 13-4, marking a tough outing for the Twins. Petey Halpin led the Twins' offense with 3 hits, including 2 home runs, while Tanner Bibee earned the win for the Guardians with 6 strong innings.

top_news.title: **Pirates Fall to Yankees in 5-8 Showdown**
top_news.summary: The New York Yankees secured a 5-8 victory over the Pittsburgh Pirates, with Jazz Chisholm Jr. leading the Pirates' offense with 2 hits, 2 home runs, and 5 RBIs. Wilber Dotel impressed on the mound for the Pirates with 3.0 IP, 5 K, 0 ER, and 0 BB.

top_news.title: **Rays Take Down Blue Jays 7-1**
top_news.summary: The Tampa Bay Rays secured a convincing 7-1 victory over the Toronto Blue Jays, with Nick Fortes leading the charge at the plate. Fortes hit a home run on a fly ball to left center field, contributing to his impressive 2-hit, 1-home run performance.

top_news.title: **Red Sox Edge Orioles in Thrilling Finish**
top_news.summary: The Boston Red Sox secured a 6-5 victory over the Baltimore Orioles, coming out on top in a closely contested matchup. Christian Encarnacion-Strand led the Orioles' offense with 2 hits, 1 home run, and 2 RBIs.

top_news.title: **Meyer Lands on Injured List**
top_news.summary: Miami Marlins right-hander Max Meyer has been placed on the 15-day injured list due to a neck strain, effective retroactive to July 19, 2026.

top_news.title: **Dodgers Acquire Seth Halvorsen in Trade**
top_news.summary: The Los Angeles Dodgers have acquired right-handed pitcher Seth Halvorsen in a trade with the Colorado Rockies. Halvorsen joins the Dodgers in exchange for right-handed pitcher Nick Frasso and outfielder Landyn Vidourek.
